title: Unresponsive
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} presents unresponsive with respiratory depression, CNS depression, and hypotonia. Pupils may be normal or slightly constricted (unlike opioid pinpoint). History of diazepam use confirmed. Benzo overdose alone rarely causes death unless mixed with other sedatives (alcohol, opioids). Flumazenil is a competitive benzodiazepine antagonist — but use with EXTREME CAUTION. Flumazenil can precipitate acute withdrawal seizures, especially in chronic benzo users or mixed overdose with TCAs. Generally NOT recommended for routine use. Treatment: supportive care — airway protection (intubate if needed), respiratory support, IV fluids, observation. Decontamination with activated charcoal if recent ingestion (<1h) and airway protected. Full recovery expected with supportive care alone for isolated benzo overdose. Toxicology screen to rule out co-ingestants. Psychiatry consult for intentional overdose.

stacks.label: Supportive care / Observation
stacks.finding: Mainstay. Avoid flumazenil — risk of seizures.
